meta.comment: Error workflow for the other two LendLoop workflows. After importing all three workflows: open this one, copy its workflow ID, and paste it into the Error Workflow setting of 'LendLoop - Request Notification' and 'LendLoop - Overdue Reminders' (their exports carry the placeholder REPLACE_WITH_LENDLOOP_ERROR_WORKFLOW_ID), then activate all three. SAFE DEFAULT: errors are logged as mock alerts; the email alert node is DISABLED with a placeholder credential.

nodes.name: Email Alert (disabled)
nodes.notes: Disabled on purpose. Configure a real SMTP credential and recipient, then enable.
